mechanism: Foscarnet can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and renal impairment that may affect hormone absorption and metabolism; medroxyprogesterone may have minimal impact on foscarnet clearance but concurrent use requires monitoring.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes, renal function, and calcium levels regularly; ensure adequate hydration during foscarnet therapy; consider contraceptive efficacy if significant GI effects occur.
